description: Ines sends a message in the group chat about the shared birthday dinner, asking who will host.
Bea replies to the group chat: 'Hey Ines, I see the question about hosting. I have the biggest kitchen but I work nights, so I need to check my schedule first. I'll let you know later today.'
Tomas notices Bea's reply in the group chat.
Bea's reply appears in the group chat, visible to all members.
Ines does not see Bea's reply in the group chat; it remains unread.
Bea checks her work calendar for October 10-11 and sees that she is scheduled to work a night shift starting at 10 PM on Saturday October 10.

Bea sends a message to the group chat: 'I checked my schedule and I'm working a night shift starting at 10 PM on Saturday Oct 10. I can host if we can start early enough to wrap up by 9:30 PM, or if everyone is okay with me leaving at 9:30. What time were you thinking?'
Kwame's phone receives the group chat messages, but he does not see them.
Ines's phone buzzes with the group chat notifications, but she is in the middle of making breakfast and doesn't look at the screen.
Ines continues making breakfast, ignoring the phone buzz.
Ines opens the group chat and sees Bea's two messages: the first saying she needs to check her schedule, and the second saying she can host if they start early enough.
Ines reads Bea's messages in the group chat and now knows Bea's offer to host with an early start or leaving at 9:30 PM.
Ines finishes making breakfast and sits down to eat, still not looking at her phone.
Ines's phone remains on the counter, unread, while she eats breakfast.
Ines finishes breakfast and goes to the counter to pick up her phone.
Ines continues eating breakfast without checking her phone.
Ines picks up her phone from the counter.
Tomas picks up his phone and sees the two new messages from Bea in the group chat.
Ines looks at her phone screen and sees the group chat notification from Bea's second message (the one offering to host with conditions).
Ines taps on the notification and opens the group chat, seeing Bea's second message in full.
Kwame's phone continues to hold the unread group chat messages, but he does not check them.
Kwame's phone continues to hold the unread group chat messages, but he does not see them.
